issues.label: Constitutional Crisis
issues.summary: Fundamental breakdown in adherence to constitutional norms, where branches of government exceed their authority or refuse to recognize the legitimacy of other branches, threatening the foundational legal order

circuits.detail: Constitutional identity and foundational self-reference weakened, eroding shared national narrative
Judicial review capacity overwhelmed or bypassed, removing checks on unconstitutional action
Executive authority expanding beyond constitutional bounds without effective constraint
Legislative voice suppressed or circumvented, reducing deliberative lawmaking capacity
Conflict-monitoring and regulatory oversight mechanisms failing to flag constitutional violations

issues.label: Regime Instability
issues.summary: Erosion of political legitimacy leading to frequent government turnover, coups, mass protests, or civil unrest that undermines stable governance and long-term policy continuity

circuits.detail: Electoral reward mechanisms distorted by voter disillusionment and declining democratic participation
Emergency powers chronically activated as crisis governance becomes the norm rather than exception
Military command increasingly involved in political transitions, eroding civilian control
Civil service continuity disrupted by purges and patronage appointments during each regime change
Long-range policy formation abandoned in favor of short-term survival calculations

issues.label: Policy Failure
issues.summary: Systematic inability to formulate, implement, or sustain effective public policy, leading to widening gaps between governance intentions and societal outcomes

circuits.detail: Policy valuation and cost-benefit analysis degraded, producing poorly designed interventions
Administrative implementation capacity insufficient to translate policy into effective action
Demographic and statistical data foundations corrupted or ignored in policy design
Regulatory feedback loops broken, preventing detection and correction of policy failures
Intelligence and analytical capacity insufficient to inform evidence-based policy decisions
Legislative drafting quality declined, producing ambiguous and unenforceable statutes

issues.label: Corruption Scandal
issues.summary: Systemic corruption permeating government institutions, where public office is exploited for private gain, eroding institutional trust and governance effectiveness

circuits.detail: Judicial evaluation of right and wrong compromised by bribery and political pressure on courts
Treasury and fiscal operations diverted toward rent-seeking and kleptocratic extraction
Regulatory oversight captured by the very interests it was designed to monitor
Civil service procedural norms replaced by patronage networks and loyalty-based appointments
Electoral incentives distorted by dark money and quid-pro-quo arrangements between donors and officials

issues.label: Diplomatic Breakdown
issues.summary: Collapse of international diplomatic channels leading to isolation, sanctions, conflict escalation, or failure of multilateral cooperation on shared challenges

circuits.detail: Perspective-taking and empathic modeling of foreign state interests severely diminished
International legal frameworks abandoned or undermined, removing structural basis for cooperation
State communications shifted from diplomatic to confrontational rhetoric, escalating tensions
Intelligence analysis failures producing inaccurate assessments of foreign state intentions
Military posturing replacing diplomatic engagement as the primary tool of foreign policy
Central banking and financial coordination channels disrupted by sanctions and counter-sanctions

issues.label: Military Overreach
issues.summary: Disproportionate military influence on governance, including excessive defense spending, politicization of the armed forces, or military intervention in civilian affairs

circuits.detail: Military command structure expanding beyond defense mandate into political and economic domains
Perpetual threat narratives sustaining permanent emergency footing and expanded military authority
Executive authority increasingly captured by or dependent upon military leadership support
Defense spending consuming disproportionate share of fiscal resources at expense of civilian programs
Legislative oversight of military operations weakened by secrecy and deference to commanders
